I know we all hate super hand-holdy games but this goes so far in the opposite direction it's not even fun. There are many unintuitive mechanics/design choices that your only real option to understand how to play is to watch some videos on how to play. Incredibly lazy decisions made by the developer, I would not buy this game at regular price or even half price. It's also quite a hostile experience trying to play with a controller, so don't even bother. I'm sure it'll get better but everything feels so stiff and clunky - this is not a game that feels good to play, maybe it feels good to overcome... I'm getting a refund though and maybe I'll give it another go if it dips below $5. I'm glad I caught myself before the 2 hour refund limit because some of the other reviews speak to issues that I wouldn't discover unless going much deeper into the game. If the controls weren't stiff and clunky, and they took 10 minutes to explain the basic mechanics of managing your raft (my first game I went to check out an island, my raft floated away, resources in the water despawned when my raft left, and I didn't have enough resources to build a new one, didn't know things could only be built on the raft, etc ,etc.) It's also far to easy too die and far too punishing when you do, so the game itself doesn't even encourage learning how to play by playing. Maybe it's more fun if you have 4 people to gather resources, stab boars, and manage a single raft - but for me this was just 2 hours of my life wasted and filled with frustration.

艾尔登法环游戏评价 前言: 我是洛云 在过去两个月里我给这部游戏《艾尔登法环》打通关了 现在距离影之刃零发布还有七小时 我决定在这个时间段卸载法环 并在Steam上发布我的第一篇游戏评价 下面对《艾尔登法环》的描述将其简称为法环 事先声明: 我不是什么专业测评媒体也不是全职游戏博主，本评价仅为一名热爱电子游戏的普通玩家结合自己的游玩体验对本游戏的所有看法和见解，每个人评分标准不同，每个游戏评分标准也不一样，所以如有不同观点欢迎在评论区讨论指正，不可能拿休闲游戏和动作游戏比操作上限，不可能拿肉鸽游戏和剧情游戏比剧情演出，最后评价如有雷同算你抄我 用一句话来概括艾尔登法环: 一场关于未知地域和神祇的宏大史诗 优点:想去哪就去哪😡 体量巨大玩法出色 同时独特的怪诞诡谲的美术和恢宏庞大的音乐风格直接给到一个夯爆了 缺点:剧情极度碎片化 对剧情的了解基本只能靠碎片去猜 有时候不看攻略根本不知道干什么 后期数值崩坏 不玩强势武器游戏体验拉完了 同时优化一坨史 综合评分:9.5分 注:综合评分取各项评分结合游戏类型加权计算后得出 玩法设计:9分 ①游戏类型和地图设计: 法环主打游戏类型开放性世界rpg游戏，每个区域都有属于自己的特色，游戏开局在推开引导之始的大门时，就能看到游戏最终目标—那棵顶天立地的黄金树。而且不管是什么建筑或者地区，基本上只要能看到的地方都能到达，能到达的地方基本都有内容，中途没有任何的空气墙阻碍，哪里能走哪里不能走做的明明白白的，只能说fs社不愧是老牌游戏公司，多年积累的地图设计功底在史东薇尔城和dlc里的幽影城展现的淋漓尽致，所有地方四通八达，可能走过了这个路口又是一个没来过的地方。但也因为这一点，法环极强的自由度也就代表了它没有太多条条框框束缚玩家，也就造成了法环游戏引导非常非常弱，不看攻略一个人探索大概率不能体验到全部内容，包括各种npc也是有各种各样的前置条件和出现时间，你不能从npc的话里面得知任何能直接听懂的信息，因为他们只会告诉你一个云山雾绕的任务目标，就这样看着我在硕大的交界地到处乱跑，稍不注意整条剧情线就直接断掉（我的罗杰尔支线就因为菲雅支线断掉了）甚至很多完整的支线攻略都是靠解包游戏文件做出来的。而且后期各种墓地和坑道同质化严重，长途跋涉+拉开关+打boss的流程让人一眼猜出接下来会怎么样，有点无聊，只有一个罗德尔地下墓地感觉设计的很不错 ②游戏流派构筑 法环里有很多的流派，我选择的是纯力战士流，可以体验到各种各样的武器，每种武器类型也有属于自己独特的攻击模组，每把武器也有属于自己的独特战技，很多武器都很帅比如尸山血海和猎龙大刀，但反而是盾戳和狮子斩巨人槌这种朴实无华的武器用的比较多，因为游戏后期和dlc的怪感觉数值都是用脚填的，等级不点高一点要么打不动怪要么被怪秒，基本上隔三差五就要往蒙格温银行跑一趟，十分破坏游戏推进节奏 ③操作体感 我是手柄玩家，一开始非常不适应魂游的这套左右肩键攻击模组，在开荒期间总是容易按到别的键位导致错失良机，而且也不支持自己改键位，所以键位部分需要适应一下 剧情演出:8.5分 ①游戏主线剧情 游戏主线剧情基本就是讲褪色者一路砍杀直到称王的故事，但如果真的从引导之始开始一路打到黄金树的话那你就会发现:这一路上我到底干了啥？这游戏到底讲了个什么故事？但如果把所有地方都七七八八的探索的差不多了，结合途中对话，所获得物品，武器和装备描述文本，能从这里面窥探出一个极其庞大的世界观—你可以知道鼎盛的黄金王朝是怎样覆灭的，群神逐鹿的破碎战争是怎样终结的，玛丽卡女王为何要反叛黄金律法？交界地为何会战火纷飞破碎不堪？在这些探索和追寻中时间就会慢慢的消磨，最后通关才发现自己原来已经玩了这么久了（但有一点很不好，就是为了游戏性把游戏设定抛弃了，比如本体中已经受赐癫火的玩家在米德拉官邸没有任何特殊剧情和对话，还有天天吃龙心用龙飨祷告也不会变成龙） ②游戏角色刻画 我个人非常喜欢各种神话故事，不同于往常书本上记载的神话，法环描述的每个神祇我们都能与之会面，我们可以在战斗庆典中看到最强半神拉塔恩，在罗德尔王城中看到身为恶兆双子之一的蒙葛特在圣树村中看到神人之一女武神玛莲妮亚，在黄金树内部看到贯穿整部法环剧情的玛丽卡女王。这些神祇不再是羊皮纸上冰冷的一个个名字，我们可以从祂们所属势力npc口中得知祂们到底是一个怎样的神？最后不断铺垫直到遇见神祇本人并挑战祂。这一套流程下来，对于会晤过的神祇印象都极其深刻，除了本体一直在铺垫的死王子葛德文。反正我是没搞懂为什么会选择拉塔恩而不是葛德文作为dlc最终boss，明明法环本体的那么多墓地和物品文本里都详细描述了这位死王子，但故事线还是没有写完，让人百思不得其解 不光是高高在上的神祇，一些凡人npc同样能让人印象深刻，我最喜欢的npc分别是本体的柏克，瑟濂和dlc的安帕赫。柏克虽实力卑微还因为自己相貌丑陋而总是感到自卑，但对救赎他的我尽心尽力，也会因为自愧而不顾死亡强行改变自己样貌。瑟濂虽然屠戮魔法学院的学子，但会在收我为徒后说出“如果没有当上艾尔登之王，就回来找我吧”她不要求我有多伟大的成就，只想着护我周全便好。最后是在人均弱智 抑郁症 狂躁症 洗脑婆的dlc中塑造形象最好的npc安帕赫，人格魅力极其伟大的一位纯血骑士，忠诚于自己侍奉的领袖，用于向亵渎自己领袖的米凯拉挑战还差点单杀，在魅惑中坚定自己信念立场，对他人想法观念表示尊重，最后死在与米凯拉的对决当中。当然塑造形象优秀npc还不止这些，比如本体的亚历山大壶dlc的埃贡也是塑造非常丰满的 但是法环各种各样的废案同样也多的数不清，比如盖利德龙墓西方的大白龙桂奥尔，除了打死拿钱以外没任何的作用了，还有别的各个地方也是，很多东西做出来都不知道干嘛的 ③cg演出 法环的cg演出质量都很高，但是我到现在还没搞懂—法环cg资源分配是怎么分的？像dlc双月骑士和花蕾圣女这种剧情占比相当大的boss为什么没有cg甚至没有描述，入场就直接开打？反而是火山官邸和别的地方就算拉个机关都要跳一段cg出来，第一次拉火山那个桥机关的时候我还以为会出现boss，结果就真的只是出现一座桥，所以有些时候真的是不明所以 ④结局分支 如果把所有支线全部做完的话，那么最后应该是有六种结局（分别是主线，群星，癫火，金面具，菲雅，食粪者） 每个结局都有各自的特点，可以根据自己对于这个时代的感受去选择怎样对待交界地，不过选择相对应的结局之后不能看到交界地到底发生了什么变化倒是挺可惜的 ⑤本地化 为了追求沧桑的神秘感，在配音上法环只有古英语，甚至连本土的日文都没有，所以没什么好讲的了。但是法环简中翻译不是很行，最典型的就是地区“湖之利耶尼亚”，甚至在米莉森支线中最后几次和格威交谈，会发现他说出来的话文本变成了繁体 美术与画质:10分 ①整体画面 法环的画质真的一般，不过法环顶级的美术弥补了这一点，统一又高级，法环整体风格就是扑朔迷离的氛围感，搭配上量大但不细化的画质，呈现出极具震撼的画面 ②游戏内各种生物设计风格具有非常独特的“魂”味，宫崎英高特别喜欢做各种各样看上去猎奇但感觉比较合理的生物 音乐与音效:10分 ①游戏中，和不同BOSS战斗时的背景音乐都大有不同，在和强大BOSS战斗时音乐也更加激昂宏伟，个人感觉前半段拉达冈的战斗曲《The Final Battle》最为震撼，中古教会调式合唱配上管弦乐队的回响，再结合游玩过程中对拉达冈的各种印象，看着沉默不语的拉达冈挥动着玛丽卡石槌，伴随着黄金律法的轰鸣声和金色特效闪烁，仿佛这位秩序化身的神明真的站在我面前 ②至于平常探索地图音效朴实无华，但都很贴合各个地区的地图特色。然后是音效真的夯神了，不管是探索交互还是战斗，每种音效都十分抓耳，仿佛真的沉浸在交界地一样，代入感极强 游戏优化:5分 法环的游戏优化直接给到一个拉爆了，很难想象一个2022年发售的游戏还只有60帧，甚至翻滚无敌帧这种游戏重要操作都和帧率绑定死了。再说优化，每次一到索尔城那个移动灵庙就卡的飞起，还有时不时就冒出来的模型变黑，特别破坏探索沉浸感 游戏体量 价格和性价比:10分 游戏本体加dlc黄金树幽影原价是368，空间大小大概是65个g左右，但是这么点大的法环可以让我玩到187h，只能说游戏体量是相当恐怖的了，加上fs社特有的素材复用，把一个庞大复杂的交界地世界缩小到这小小的65g里，性价比直接给到一个夯爆了 个人体感 如果你喜欢自己一个人自由探险，或者是体验交界地的异域风情玩家，那么法环将非常适合你，一周目保底时长都有100h 但如果你只喜欢根据设定好的线性流程游玩，或者不喜欢受苦受难和高难度游戏，那么法环将非常不适合你，因为游戏内真的充满了制作者的满满恶意 后记 虽然法环有各种各样的缺点，优化烂，剧情打哑巴迷，但通关之后一切都云淡风轻了，法环好的地方可以让我完全原谅这个游戏的各种不足，回味过来发现法环好像确实是一部好作品 总之玩的时候宫崎英高老牧师了，通关之后宫崎英高老牧活了

无人深空是一个超赞的游戏，这是一个有着丰富系统和超高自由度的游戏。就以我目前这几十个小时的体验来说这个游戏的体量是很大的创新也是很超前的，这里有丰富的星系和星球还有各种各样的飞船还有数不清生物群系这无疑对游戏整体添加了更多的乐趣，这个游戏我感觉对于配置低的电脑也是很有好的能感觉到制作组对游戏的优化是非常棒并且此游戏从2016发行至今让在推送大量且玩法丰富的更新并且永不收费。所以我对于这个游戏的评价是非常棒AWA

This is probably my favorite game of all time, and I have at least double the hours in this then any other (Steam is showing about 1200 right now if that's important to you). I adore the Don't Starve series, and DST (Don't Starve Together) especially. It's a fantastic game with significantly more content then it looks like. I've been playing on an off since 2016 and there's always something new to work on or seek out (seriously there's a major update at least a few times a year with free content). The game lore is incredible, and well worth the time to understand and play toward. Not exactly a "horror" or "spooky" game, but it has a very cool Tim-Burton-esq art style and I have also found it fun to listen to halloween music while playing to heighten the ~vibes~. Most aspects of the game are customizable in game and world gen settings. So you can turn off frog rain if it's the bane of your Spring seasons, or play in an eternal autumn as one of my friends has done. You can increases bosses to lots, or turn out the lights for an entirely different run. If you just want to hang out and farm (with the incredibly complex farming system) you totally can, or you can completely ignore the mechanic all together. Whatever you like best you can spend time on, and if making a base or hunting bosses, or seafaring isn't up your alley there's enough content to skip your least favorite parts and still have so so much to do. But you'll have a more complete experience if you try a bit of everything. I have found that generally DST rewards time and knowledge spent, and the more difficult an enemy or obstacle appears, the more rewarding it is to conquer (and the better the loot too)! That said, this is a survival game, and it is hard. When players say everything can kill you, we're not exaggerating. There's a steep learning curve, especially from brand new to intermediate, and the game itself gives you little to no instruction. Don't panic. Part of the fun is experimenting and (probably) dying to something silly. (But if you want more explanation there are many amazing guides out there; I'm partial to the youtube ones myself.) If you're not a hardcore gamer, or don't pick up on gaming things quickly, same! I've been able to have so much fun at a beginner level and I still think this is worth it. If you're a more advanced player there are some really cool raid bosses to take on that I think you'll really enjoy. If you're into mods, there are many and they are super easily applied to the game (via Steam Workshop). Honestly, this game was the first I played with mods, and I'm sad every time I add mods to anything else because it's so much more work lol. I typically play solo, but multiplayer is active and enjoyable when I can convince people to play with me lol. I have found that it's generally good to get the basics down solo before attempting to play with others but ymmv. If DST is looking too overwhelming, maybe check out Don't Starve first. I really think this series is worth the effort, time, and money and if Together seems too far out of your skill level, the single player games might a better fit for you. Enemies have significantly lower heath pools, and the vanilla Don't Starve has a lot less going on in general. A great place to start if the art and story are interesting but you're not as interested in combat. I almost always play on my desktop but I have also played on a laptop as well as a Nintendo Switch (but not a Steam Deck, so might be different) and I found handheld/console really frustrating. It might be because I've put so many hours on pc that console controls really messed up my playing, but gameplay became clunky and overall less suited to controller or handheld gaming then I would have preferred. I really wouldn't suggest this as a game to play on an already slow laptop, but any desktop and most laptops of middling speed/quality should be able to handle it. If you have a slow laptop (like mine was rip) the game will likely play, but the lag could be anywhere from workable to almost inoperable. Btw, this is exponentially compounded if you are trying to play with others. For example: a slow-ish game solo might become unplayable with a friend on the server even if by yourself it's doable. I've never written a game review before, so hopefully this is helpful for someone! I figured I had over a thousand hours just on this account so it was probably time to share my experiences with one of my go-to games:)

从一开场，滚5就展现了高超的制作水平。你和你操控的角色都是初到天际，对背景故事一无所知，在马车上的交谈中窥见世界的一角，在刑场登记信息时捏脸，在逃离龙的袭击时学会移动，在与帝国兵的冲突中学会基本的战斗操作，在地牢中搜刮物品学会和环境互动和开锁，在躲藏熊的时候学会潜行……直到逃出洞穴，看到远处覆雪的荒瀑古坟，一首《Far Horizons》响起，你完全自由了，在这个陌生的天际。没有给定的任务路线，没有空气墙和等级限制，“看见那座山了吗？你可以爬上去。” 经验值不来自杀敌，不来自完成任务，不来自白痴学者，玩家变强的路只有一条：你玩得多。滚5的等级来自于你所有熟练项的熟练度的总和，刀剑、魔法、锻造、炼金、附魔……所有技能的起点都是一样的，玩家不需要在一开始就决定存档里要当什么职业吃什么增益，你只需要多尝试自然就会了。当然也不排除一些技能设计失衡，譬如无脑强的钳工流和三神左脚踩右脚。一些技能的形同滚木，滚5的口才系统相比于辐射实属是一坨，除了能少花点钱和跳过一些重复劳动以外毫无用处，无法获得任何额外的重要信息；开锁技能树更是全程几乎零收益。再由于开场中没有法术教学，加之剧情中诺德人的文化旋律，本游戏的法术系统一直都有些被忽视，大部分玩家包括我除非被堵路或推剧情都鲜少使用魔法。但起码在原版内容里，法术的丰富程度要远胜于冷兵器，五大学派的法术设计都很完善，输出、奶、幻术或是摇人，玩法选择比只有我砍我再砍的近战武器好太多了。 任务设计，优秀夹杂着平庸。滚5有大量剧情优秀体验沉浸的任务线，主线、内战、战友团、工会、兄弟会、学院、龙裔和黎明守卫8条中除了内战战友团学院稍逊，其余几条甚至足以拿来单开一部3A游戏。除此还有大量游离在线外的优秀魔神任务和城市任务。但还是有两大缺点：1.依旧有不少通马桶，事实上滚5的马桶是无限制的，在你把地图杀光前无限刷新。而精品支线是有限的，且大部分都可以在第一次抵达相关城市获取，因此不难感受到玩得越久、马桶含量越高。2.任务分支平淡，绝大多数任务都是线性的，不像辐射和博德任务的错综，实话讲滚5还远远没有摸到网状叙事的门槛，剩下的一小部分也常常只是一个道德层面的二择。 不避讳地说，和互联网大多数人的观点一样，滚5原版的打击感确实是一坨大便，但处决动画还挺帅的。如果你作为资深老屁股不在意这些便无所谓，如果在意可以通过打Attack MCO-DXP来解决。 [h3]美学：19/20[/h3] 天际，诺德，粗犷的北境。大地的绝大部分由白雪覆盖，冻岩冻土上永远飘荡着不死的冰雾，地势崎岖山峦耸立，天空绝大部分时间只雾蒙蒙，偶尔才能瞥见几眼太阳，让远处山的轮廓可见。星空，极光和两颗卫星之下，到处都是废弃的洞穴、古坟和矮人遗迹，被强盗和弃誓者盘踞，山花、浆果、草荚、松和其他枯树是主流的植被，远处时不时传来龙的吼叫。遍布薰衣草的白漫、四季如秋的裂谷、山岩拼接的马卡斯、偶然出现的巨大神像和湮灭领域风格迥异的建筑与装潢点缀这个冰冷的世界，天际的美术充满了灵魂。独自行走在其中，正如同本作11年11月11日的发售时间一般孤独。 叙事方面，许多任务线的叙事都相当优秀，保持了高度的戏剧冲突：玩家在黑暗兄弟会执行重大刺杀任务的同时不得不卷入组织内部的权力斗争、黎明守卫的推动就意味着和哈孔的对抗等；人物塑造也相当鲜明，瑟拉娜、帕图纳克斯、西塞罗等角色都令人印象深刻；但叙事节奏拉胯：全程站桩对话，NPC走路时而墨迹时而又不等人。环境本身也在叙事，一处强盗营地的信件、尸体和物品摆放，就可以让玩家推测这里发生了什么，一个疯乞丐的言语，就能透露村子尘封的历史，这些叙事不直接服务任务，却在细枝末节中透出世界的真实感。玩家也是一种叙事，你做过什么，城中的卫兵会对此夸赞或者讽刺，NPC会出现额外的对话选项。 上古卷轴的世界观是我见过最奇特的虚构世界观。在全天际中你能获得大量不同主题和类型的书籍，你会发现其中不同的种族对不同的神称呼、看法和历史记载均不一，模糊的历史为玩家提供了充分的想象空间和代入感。如同真实的世界一样，你不知道为什么遗迹会长成那样、为什么政治和宗教会在此冲突，但这确实发生了。这是一种相比碎片化叙事更高明的手法。 [h3]游戏哲学：10/10[/h3] 想尽办法让玩家沉浸在游戏其中，这是Bethesda长期坚持的设计理念中的首要一件。沉浸感，一切夸赞上古卷轴5的文案都会提及的部分。在游戏中，玩家不再是一个扮演主角剧本的外世之人，我就是龙裔本身，我做的就是龙裔做的，龙裔的行为就是我的行为，在小小的屏幕中，二者完全达成了统一。不知多少次当我关闭exe，转头望向窗外微白的天空时，猛然意识到又回到了原来的世界，变成了一个其他的角色。 NPC的灵性绝对是讨论上古卷轴5时无法绕开的。每个城市中数十个有名有姓的NPC都有一套自己的行程表，日出而作日入而息、偶尔去一趟城里的神殿祈祷、或在酒店做些站场子的工作，熟悉的人相互遇到的时候也会交流打趣，即使没有玩家，天际省的时间依旧能自然流动下去。当然玩家对NPC造成的交互也同样生动，会问是吸血鬼或狼人的玩家身上的某些特征，玩家掏出武器和魔法时让玩家放下或走开，根据玩家不同的技能水平做出点评；玩家直接或间接造成NPC的死亡，他的家人可能会改变对你的态度和台词，甚至改变自己的工作。当你路过路边两个天天争吵的NPC并插了一次话后，可能就会开启一小时甚至几小时的一条支线任务。NPC在玩家的眼中变得更加重要，而不是一堆围着转的工具人。这是一个你不用只盯着头上冒出感叹号的NPC的游戏，NPC的设计正是上古卷轴5沉浸感的第一大来源。 十五年后回头来看，滚5的城市简直就是一个破村子，村子更是两栋烂房子拼成的怎么看都像在从事非法活动的不明聚集点。但这在我看来完全不是缺点，NPC可以密集聚居，方便他们之间的演出，游戏里的几乎每栋房子都有有名有姓的NPC可以交流触发任务推动剧情。嘴一下Bethesda，这种良好习惯自辐射4就不再有了，为了扩充地图那个byd新手村康科德就开始加入一堆无法进入的房屋，实属破坏体验。野外的兴趣地点也相当丰富，可以说滚5用着系列最小的地图容纳了系列最丰富的内容，许多地点可能同时有二到三条任务一同指向，一个任务又涉及两三个地点，清晰又庞大的任务网便这么展开了。游戏后期打开地图，看着立体的3D地图和上面密密麻麻承载故事的地点，充实感油然而生。地图设计的优秀是沉浸感的另一大来源。 所见即所得。滚5的所有生物都有着和玩家一视同仁的逻辑，背包里有什么就用什么穿什么，掉落物品不再是一坨预设好的序列，你看到一个强盗头头有发光的宝剑，杀了他或偷过来就能拿到，看到一个贵族有钻石制的项链，杀了他或偷过来就能拿到，不会有随机爆神级戒指的小龙虾、不用天天蹲在性价比高的野怪刷新点。一切杂物都有自己的独立建模，可以被随意摆在桌上扔在地上或扣在NPC的头上，更好的盾牌不是仅仅数值高一点，你可以在物品栏打开它，放大查看细节、雕纹，就和在NPC和你手上拿的时候一样。这是第三大来源。 [h3]完成度：8/15[/h3] Bug, bug never changes. 玩家会自己生产优化游戏的内容，这便是Bethesda所坚持的第二件。我的沉浸感不知多少次被Bug破坏得粉碎，九圣灵在上，不是所有bug都如同巨人航天一样有意思。 另外从不少代码和隐藏房间中可以看出，Bethesda自己也砍掉了不少有意思的支线，算是这个制作组的通病了。 [h3]内容量：10/10[/h3] 十五年已过，天际依旧是社区活力最强规模最庞大的单机游戏。可能这个title不会改变，如果你在滚6发行之前不幸趋势了。我全成就用了190h。具体内容可见“游戏哲学”一栏。 但是聊上古卷轴不可避免的便是它的mod社区。Creation Engine这个引擎就拥有这么一个神奇的魔力，一切都可以自己修改。画质上跟不上时代了？我们有高清纹理mod、光影优化mod、光追路追mod、高模mod、天气系统mod，角色改进更是完全开出了一片新领域。战斗太无聊了？我们有动作系统mod、伤害系统mod，你可完全把它改装成ARPG。内容不够玩？我们有数不清的内容拓展mod，新任务、新地区、新的剧情NPC。细节不够精致？站桩对话修改mod、丰富婚姻系统mod、自由视角mod、UImod……而且，模组前置的机制可以让mod身上再长出mod，把你想要的继续客制化。不少优秀的任务mod会被官方转正成游戏内容，甚至一个新的二创游戏。这是一个由玩家作为创作者的平台，但bethesda的吃相实在是太sm了，差评中99%都是有关这点的。 [h3]创新性：9/10[/h3] 第一个大满贯游戏，划时代的意义。把辐射3/新维加斯那种传统的桌游化的CRPG体系大幅改进，复杂的系统在新玩家眼中尽可能消失，但在老玩家眼中又不失深度，是一种相当适合电子游戏的设计理念。 [h3]黑箱：9/10[/h3] 陶大炮，我再信你一次。

Probably in the ball park of about -1000 hours across all platforms. I've been playing 'World' on- and off now since around 2020, and have never considered the game to be bad. No matter how long my break is I always end up revisiting it for a couple of months at a time. I have beaten every monster, (excluding Safi, and Kulve*) solo; so as far as reviews go- the average solo player can look to me to get insight on what the experience will be like. I want to leave this review to really open up a gods-honest opinion, giving a good and bad part about every instance in the game. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- THE GRIND: Yes, monster hunter is grindy. You should absolutely not expect to play this game without sinking upwards of 50+ hours in farming- and gear grinding. In reality, that estimate is probably much larger depending on a variety of variables. The game has tedious mechanics at times- and can definitely impact a long time playthrough without breaks, which could lead to burnout. This grind only exponentially grows throughout the game, as the base game is generally much more manage-able than the DLC. With this being said, the grind is absolutely not as demoralizing as one might expect. As far as I was concerned, I still had tons of fun farming, and sometimes- although arduous the feeling of finally getting a rare drop or finally crafting a piece of gear more than made up for the time spent getting it. You can really dump hours upon hours into creating your own builds, and experimenting with different weapons. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ARTWORK: The monsters- and characters are some of the most memorable things in the game for me. I love the artwork and design of the creatures you fight in this game, and how they embed themselves into the environment. The immersion comes from the danger, and that some monsters are outright- terrifying to come across. The nature, and geography of the locations you traverse through are also gorgeous, and have proper- depth and design. A lot of the creatures develop their powers from the locale which they are most commonly found- which helps again to build on that immersion. The design of the armor is honestly a 50/50. Some sets have stunning looks, while others can look really funny. There is no shortage of "fashion" or designs out there, so the possibility of customizing your character is really endless when it comes to color, monster parts, or themes. In-fact, a substantial amount of my playtime was also spent getting vanity gear, which includes cosmetics to drip out my character. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- COMMUNITY: Don't reference your experience to isolationists who villainize the game by targeting people who don't use their weapon. The monster hunter experience is wonderful, and is intended to be played as you see fit. Although there are definitely do's and don'ts in multiplayer, id say probably around 90% of the player-base are genuinely helpful, kind players. I love this, as coming from previous games It felt as if the community for monster hunter was a really welcoming experience when I started out. There are some utterly jaw-dropping clips, and speed runs out there. The talent of the community and the competition between fastest-speed runs never ceased to amaze me as an average player. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- DIFFICULTY: There is some stigma out there- that confuses difficulty for annoyance. Some monsters in this game are annoying to fight, with gimmicky mechanics. That is not the same as difficult monsters. Besides the obvious endgame challenges- there really aren't too many monsters that the average player couldn't beat or would have trouble fighting. Hell, even Fatalis- which took me about a month of planning fell eventually, which was done multiple times with un-optimal builds and countless mistakes. Everything can be learned, and no one should be deterred by a monster just because it seems difficult. This game is really not too challenging, and for the most part, the average monster will at-most, just keep you on your toes rather than require you to completely focus on it. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- STORY: I'm going to be honest. The story in monster hunter is really nothing to go all crazy about. The characters lack depth, and have corny- random lines. The beauty in the story doesn't really come from the acting or narrative, but rather the climax. Most end-fights or fights that are big canonical moments make up for little filler monsters. For example, I really enjoyed Valkanas's ark, as well as the Shara-Ishvalda story, regardless of how their fights were. The characters do have interactions with each other but they seem quite dull, and lifeless at times. To be quite frank, the story is also really not what we want out of the game- as we more than make up for its qualities with strong combat and mechanics. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 100% TROPHY: So that just about covers it- community, experience, and game design. The last thing I wanted to touch upon is something that I myself have been apt to. There are many, people out there who consider themselves completionists. This game, naturally- comes along with a set of 100 achievements which can be completed throughout the story and the side-quests. My honest- truth is that if your are thinking about going for the platinum trophy on monster hunter-DONT. I am not even going to get started on the implications of some of these achievements, but the only thing that anyone needs to know is that a general sum of the achievements are solely reliant on RNG. RNG numbers in-fact- that are not common in the slightest. I want to make it clear that a 100% trophy in this game will come up to 600 or more hours of playtime for the average player- especially if your playing solo. I am currently at the 500 hour mark on my character, (which i started in December of 2024), and have just-now, gotten to the "endgame" achievements AKA crown hunting. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- I am personally planning on completing world in the foreseeable future, getting my platinum and getting the hell out of dodge. My experience with this game has lasted me through some of the most memorable moments in my life, and because of it this game belongs to a special area in my heart. I know that deep down, I will always admire it- but I would love to move on to 'Wilds' at some point. So for those who have played 'Wilds' - and want to check out other monster hunter experiences, try World. The UI and initial loop of the game can be confusing for brand new players but in the long run- I expect that there are more than a few who might enjoy this game as much as I have for the last six years of my life.

Most of the people giving this game a thumbs-up probably don't even play it anymore. A lot of the positive opinions seem to come from nostalgia or a few flashy gameplay moments. But if you actually play the game seriously, you quickly realize how many frustrating mechanics it has. Here are just a few examples: * **Advanced-tech wars:** The moment you reach the advanced tech era, suddenly BARBAR TANKS or BARBAR SAM launchers start spawning out of literally nowhere. No warning, no reasonable explanation — they just appear because the game wants to punish you. You can be rich, powerful, and well-prepared, and the game basically says: *"Oh, you're doing well? Let's make your gameplay poor and bad because we can."* * **DLC multiplayer:** The game is so badly designed that if YOU own a DLC but your friend doesn't, your friend can't properly join/play with you. It's basically the game saying: *"Your friend doesn't have the DLC? Too bad. Go play something else with your broke buddy."* So yeah, nostalgia can make people remember this game fondly, but nostalgia doesn't magically make bad mechanics good. If you're looking for a strategy game, there are plenty of better options. **Don't play this just because people remember it fondly.**

The theme of the game is interesting, the idea of slowly building up a base from nothing a la skyblocks is really fun and cool! The story is very written very poorly and is very boring, the different islands you go are mostly bland and uninspired landscapes with very little details that immerse you in the game. Your base becomes a habitat full of administrative tasks that keep you running back and forth from chests to the thing you're working on and it doesn't feel great. The movement itself feels sluggish and like you don't quite exist in the world due to the floaty yet sluggish feel of the character and how they interact with the geometry in the world. I had a fun time but I left with a lot to desire upon completing the game. I think this idea will likely be taken by another team with a similar idea and elevate the experience, which I welcome as this game certainly has good bones but a poor presentation of everything else. 6/10 wouldn't recommend.

好玩，好玩，这个11年的老游戏是我之前国庆促销买的，一开始是看价格这么低评分又这么高买的。虽然我完全是一个老滚5小白，完全没有玩过之前b社的游戏，也不太了解陶德什么的，但是玩了147个小时后依旧意犹未尽。画质很古老，不过是11年的游戏可以理解，繁体有点难受，不过有很简单的简体汉化mod，我也只是打了这一个，毕竟我算一个比较纯粹的游戏玩家，喜欢玩纯粹一点。战斗操作手法确实很没有打击感，也很不习惯，玩这么久也没有发现身体部位暴击什么的，比如打头没有暴击的感觉，当然也有可能是因为没有伤害数字什么的，只能纯看敌人血量条来判断。负重什么的很难受，不过也很真实，不可能一开始就有无限背包，要加耐力点或者专门的装备才可以提升。至于升级只给一点属性和升级慢也确实难受，不过游戏里有很多训练老师可以帮忙升级，不过要钱，技能等级升得越高钱要得越多，不过有一点很好玩的就是，有的技能训练师可以招募为随从，然后花的钱可以拿回来，可以白嫖。个人感觉最好玩的是偷窃这个技能，非常不可思议，当我把技能点满后可以对大多数npc扒光，让我对于偷窃这个技能有非常强的交互感。然后就是开放程度，虽然感觉地图很小，骑马一个小时差不多可以横跨地图（马也是真的慢，不过爬山确实好用，玩家和马简直是岩羊来的，是坡就能爬），但是npc的生活轨迹确实存在，这是现在大部分我玩过的游戏都没有的感觉，特别是好感度这个东西，现在大部分游戏的好感度系统是显性的，就是确实可以看见的，但是老滚5的隐性的，表现在拿东西这个方面，npc并不是只会在特定地方，而是有自己的生活轨迹（这点让人又爱又恨，因为找人确实有点麻烦）。最好玩的应该是动态的任务与实力系统，简单说就是没有等级限制和必须要完成的任务说法，虽然龙裔确实是主线，但是你不推也可以玩下去，我现在玩147小时只是推到要猎杀第一条龙的地步。很多看起来非常强的boss靠磨也是可以推过去的，并不需要要很好的武器或者准备什么的，我到目前为止最难的一个任务也是3小时磨过去的，不过后面等级上去，也快了很多。还有就是在游戏里的书是真的有用，虽然有的书看了会升技能导致我之前一直认为书只是升技能的，但是在我无聊看书的时候确实发现很多东西确实可以用，比如神射手这本书，还有附魔标准（应该是这个名字吧，有点记不清了），讲的东西确实都有用，还有一些书让我很惊奇，就是猩红匕首这本书，里面的人物并不只是传说，游戏里面确确实实是有相关人物的........还有太多太多给我惊喜的地方。总的来说，老滚5游戏手感还有画质差了很多，但是其他方面方放到现在依旧是一个好游戏。

(This review contains minor mechanical spoilers, and mentions minor details about the sequel at the end) Hades is one of the few games I always enjoy returning to, even after having completed the full story several times. The incredible attention to detail and unique style present in every aspect of the game have always impressed me, from the first time I played. The story is extremely well-written, immersive, and impactful. I was hooked to it and eager to progress it all the way through, and have started up a new save file to experience it again several times over the years. Progress feels meaningful and personal. More than any other game I have played, the world feels developed and alive. Characters have depth and respond to the things the player does, sometimes in the funniest and most unexpected ways. After over 200 hours of gameplay, I still encounter dialogues I haven't seen before. I greatly enjoy the combat system. It's simple but also has a high ceiling to develop your skill, and there is lots of room for personal preference. There are many mechanics which exist to provide variety to the builds you can make and incentives for exploring that variety, but also freedom to play the way you want to. There is room to choose how difficult you want the game to be— whether more casual to experience the story, or more challenging to push your limits. Players who enjoy challenges can utilize some optional mechanics that increase the difficulty in creative ways which push you to make use of everything you can, and be rewarded for doing so. Unlike many games, it's not just artificial difficulty either, there is genuinely unique content to enjoy in doing so (i.e. not just numbers going up, which is part of it, but also interesting twists and enemies gaining new attacks & abilities). There is also SO much content and replayability. Outside of the main story, there are so many other things you can choose to explore and progress, including side storylines, customizations, challenges, additional worldbuilding, and more. It doesn't feel like a chore, either— you can work on many things at once by just playing the game. Completionists can have a field day trying to max everything out if they so please. And, since the dungeons are randomized and there are so many build choices, no two runs feel the same. You are compelled to improve your adaptability and be ready for anything. At the same time, I would say the RNG is well-balanced, and there are systems you can unlock to greatly mitigate build-based RNG once you start finding ones you like to go for. Overall, I would say Hades deserves all the awards and nominations it's received and more, and I can easily recommend it to a variety of players. You can tell the developers put the utmost of their efforts and passion into making it. I love the art style and original music so much I've used screenshots as my desktop background and listen to the music outside of the game. With Hades 2 out now, there's even more to look forward to afterwards. I would highly recommend playing the original first, as while Hades 2 has its own story, it builds on the story from the first game and has lots of fun references.
